projects.name: SkillCheck2
projects.description: Technical-interview platform built with Next.js and TypeScript: interviewers schedule sessions and run live video interview rooms with a built-in code editor, backed by Clerk authentication, Stream video, and a Convex real-time database.

projects.name: Talkify
projects.description: Full-stack real-time chat application with Socket.io messaging, online-presence tracking, and JWT authentication. Node.js/Express and MongoDB on the backend; React, Zustand, and TailwindCSS on the frontend, with Cloudinary for image uploads.

projects.name: AdvanceRestApi
projects.description: Spring Boot REST API with a clean layered architecture: controller, service, and Spring Data JPA repository tiers, request/response DTOs mapped via ModelMapper, and a Maven build.

projects.name: Parking-Lot-LLD-
projects.description: Low-level design of a multi-floor parking lot in Java: multiple vehicle and spot types, bus parking across five consecutive large spots, ticket-based park/unpark flows, and SOLID-driven class design using Strategy and Template Method patterns.

projects.name: mlops-app
projects.description: End-to-end MLOps pipeline on Google Cloud: Terraform-provisioned infrastructure, Prefect orchestration, dbt transformations in BigQuery, MLflow experiment tracking, and a Dockerized FastAPI model-serving API deployed to Cloud Run via GitHub Actions.

projects.name: multi-agentic-rag
projects.description: Multi-agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation system built with LangChain, Groq LLMs, and Streamlit: routes queries across retrieval, query-reformulation, and web-search agents with self-correction, fact-checking, and safety-check stages.

projects.name: create-million-parameter-llm-from-scratch
projects.description: A 2.3-million-parameter LLaMA-style language model implemented from scratch in PyTorch, covering RMSNorm pre-normalization, rotary positional embeddings, and SwiGLU activations, trainable without high-end GPU hardware.
